record.question: In which city was India's first fulldome 3D Digital Theatre opened?
record.explanation: Answer B: Kolkata. National Council of Science Museums records inauguration of India’s first fulldome 3 D digital theatre at Science City, Kolkata, on 18 February 2019. This specific fulldome 3 D facility is different from a claim that no earlier planetarium or digital theatre existed anywhere in India. Reference: https://ncsm.gov.in/media/press-release/fulldome-3d-digital-theatre-inaugurated-at-science-city-kolkata. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
